lines.text: @maya_front stands wedged between commuters, one hand on the pole.
Her phone buzzes. She pulls it from her coat pocket.
She answers and covers her other ear against the rumble.
Wait, say that again. You're kidding!
She bursts out laughing, eyes bright, the crowd forgotten.
Strangers glance over, and one of them smiles too.
The train glides on; her smile holds, the call still clear.
